english.notes:
(i) Section 1 of the Act applies to the Pit Bull terrier, the Japanese Tosa and any other type designated by order of the Secretary of State. The Dogo Argentino and Fila Braziliero were designated by SI 1991/1743.
(ii) Where known, any detail as to the identity of the particular dog in question may be included at the "specify type of dog" option. (e.g. registration number) in addition to the breed.
(iii) Section 1(4) excepts acts done with a view to a dog being removed from the UK before 30th November 1991.
(iv) See section 1(7)(b) for defence re publishers of advertisements. A publisher of an advertisement shall not be imprisoned if he published it to the order of another and did not himself devise it (section 1(7)(a)).
(v) A court may make a destruction order and disqualify the offender from having custody of a dog (section 4 as amended by the Dangerous Dogs (Amendment) Act 1997).
(vi) A court may make a contingent destruction order, see section 4A.
(vii) See also offence wordings H2755 and H2756.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
